name: Strawberry Cough | Melted Diamond Live Resin Vaporizer | 1g (Ready-To-Use)
description: DIAMONDS INSIDE Our live resin diamonds, extracted from fresh frozen flowers, use a gradual separation process creating large faceted diamond-like crystals. The 99%+ potency diamond crystals are then liquefied, producing the highest potency vaporizers on the market. This sweet berry blast delivers an energizing head high that's perfect for crushing your to-do list or getting those creative juices flowing. Berry Skunk Sweet
